Incident INC-1001 on Payment API (Production): SSL Certificate Error.
Severity: Critical.
Description: SSL/TLS handshake failure on payment gateway endpoint
Recent change: Upgraded payment gateway client library last week
Root cause: Root cause: SSL certificate expired on payment gateway vendor endpoint.
Resolution: Resolution: Renewed certificate with vendor and updated client certificate configuration.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Restarting payment service (certificate issue unrelated to service health).
Lesson: Lesson: Set up automated certificate expiry monitoring with 30-day alerts for Payment API.

Incident INC-1002 on Authentication API (Production): 401 Unauthorized Bulk Failures.
Severity: Critical.
Description: Widespread authentication failures across all services
Recent change: Rotated JWT signing keys as part of quarterly security review
Root cause: Root cause: JWT signing key rotation deployed without updating key verification configuration on dependent services.
Resolution: Resolution: Updated key verification configuration on all consumer services and performed rolling restart.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Reverting authentication service (keys were correct; consumers had stale key reference).
Lesson: Lesson: JWT key rotation requires coordinated deployment with all consumers. Use key versioning and overlap periods.

Incident INC-1003 on Notification Service (Production): Message Delivery Failure.
Severity: High.
Description: Email and SMS notifications not being delivered
Recent change: Deployed new Kubernetes node pool for notification workers
Root cause: Root cause: Queue consumer pods crashed due to missing environment variable in new node pool configuration.
Resolution: Resolution: Added missing SMTP_HOST environment variable to pod spec and redeployed.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Restarting queue consumers without fixing environment (pods kept crashing).
Lesson: Lesson: Validate all required environment variables in deployment pipeline before rollout.

Incident INC-1004 on Order Service (Production): High Latency.
Severity: High.
Description: Order lookup latency spiked from 50ms to 8000ms
Recent change: Ran database migration adding order history archive table
Root cause: Root cause: Database migration added archive table but removed index on orders.customer_id causing full table scans.
Resolution: Resolution: Recreated index concurrently: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_customer_id ON orders(customer_id).
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Scaling up Order Service replicas (bottleneck was DB query, not compute).
Lesson: Lesson: Always include index verification in migration scripts for high-traffic tables.

Incident INC-1005 on Redis Cache (Production): Connection Timeout.
Severity: High.
Description: Redis connection timeouts across all services
Recent change: Increased session TTL from 2 hours to 24 hours for improved UX
Root cause: Root cause: Redis memory exhausted due to TTL increase causing too many cached sessions to accumulate simultaneously.
Resolution: Resolution: Set maxmemory policy to allkeys-lru and evicted stale data. Reduced session TTL to 4 hours.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Restarting Redis (data loss without maxmemory policy set would have caused cache stampede).
Lesson: Lesson: Always set Redis maxmemory and eviction policy. Monitor memory utilization when changing TTLs.

Incident INC-1006 on API Gateway (Production): 504 Gateway Timeout.
Severity: Critical.
Description: All API calls timing out through the gateway
Recent change: Ran marketing campaign causing 10x traffic spike
Root cause: Root cause: API Gateway upstream timeout set too low (5s) for upstream services under high load. Services were responding but slowly.
Resolution: Resolution: Increased API Gateway upstream timeout to 30s and added circuit breaker rules. Scaled up upstream services.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Restarting API Gateway (issue was timeout config, not gateway health).
Lesson: Lesson: API Gateway timeouts should be tuned based on upstream p99 latency under load, not p50.

Incident INC-1007 on User API (Production): 429 Too Many Requests.
Severity: Medium.
Description: Users unable to complete sign-up flow
Recent change: Ran targeted email campaign driving 50k new sign-up attempts
Root cause: Root cause: Rate limiter configured at 100 req/min per IP blocked legitimate users behind shared NAT/proxy.
Resolution: Resolution: Switched rate limiting to per-account rather than per-IP and increased global limit.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Disabling rate limiter entirely (would have allowed bot attacks).
Lesson: Lesson: Rate limiting on shared IPs blocks legitimate users. Use account-level or token-bucket per user.

Incident INC-1008 on Search Service (Production): Out of Memory.
Severity: High.
Description: Search service pods OOMKilled repeatedly
Recent change: Updated search index to include product descriptions (larger documents)
Root cause: Root cause: Lucene search index buffer not released after query, causing memory leak with larger documents.
Resolution: Resolution: Added query-level buffer limit and upgraded search library version that fixed the leak.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Increasing pod memory limit (only delayed the OOM crash).
Lesson: Lesson: Memory leaks require root cause fix, not just resource limit increases. Profile memory on library upgrades.

Incident INC-1009 on PostgreSQL Database (Production): Max Connections Exceeded.
Severity: Critical.
Description: Database refusing new connections
Recent change: Deployed 5 new microservices all connecting to the main database
Root cause: Root cause: Total connection pool across all services exceeded PostgreSQL max_connections (100) after new deployments.
Resolution: Resolution: Deployed PgBouncer connection pooler. Reduced per-service pool size. Increased max_connections to 200.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Restarting PostgreSQL (connections reestablished immediately).
Lesson: Lesson: Use a connection pooler (PgBouncer) for multi-service architectures. Set max_connections budget per service.

Incident INC-1010 on File Storage Service (Production): Disk Full Error.
Severity: High.
Description: File uploads failing with 500 errors
Recent change: Temporarily disabled cleanup job to avoid touching production data during migration
Root cause: Root cause: Scheduled cleanup job was disabled and disk reached 100% capacity with temporary upload files.
Resolution: Resolution: Manually cleaned temporary files, re-enabled cleanup job, added disk space alert at 80%.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Increasing instance size (disk was 100% full, new capacity still needed cleanup).
Lesson: Lesson: Never disable cleanup jobs without a time-boxed plan and disk space monitoring.

Incident INC-1011 on Order Service (Staging): Database Deadlock.
Severity: Medium.
Description: Order creation failing intermittently
Recent change: Refactored order transaction to update inventory and payments simultaneously
Root cause: Root cause: Concurrent transactions acquiring locks in different order (inventory then payment vs payment then inventory) caused deadlocks.
Resolution: Resolution: Enforced consistent lock acquisition order: always inventory first, then payment.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Increasing transaction timeout (deadlocks retried and failed again).
Lesson: Lesson: Always acquire database locks in consistent order across all transactions to prevent deadlocks.

Incident INC-1012 on Authentication API (Production): Stale Session Tokens.
Severity: Medium.
Description: Users still accessing system after account deactivation
Recent change: Switched from stateful sessions to stateless JWT tokens
Root cause: Root cause: JWT tokens are stateless; no token revocation mechanism. Deactivated users retained valid tokens.
Resolution: Resolution: Implemented token blacklist in Redis and added revocation check on each request.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Setting very short JWT expiry (1 minute) - degraded UX too severely.
Lesson: Lesson: Stateless JWTs require revocation mechanism for account deactivation/logout scenarios.

Incident INC-1013 on Search Service (Production): Empty Search Results.
Severity: High.
Description: All search queries returning 0 results
Recent change: Ran search index rebuild over the weekend
Root cause: Root cause: Index rebuild failed midway due to storage timeout, leaving a corrupted partial index that was swapped live.
Resolution: Resolution: Rolled back to previous index snapshot and implemented index rebuild validation before swap.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Reindexing again without validation (same failure would occur).
Lesson: Lesson: Always validate index rebuild completion before swapping. Implement blue-green index deployment.

Incident INC-1014 on Notification Service (Production): Email Delivery Delay.
Severity: Medium.
Description: Transactional emails delayed by 4+ hours
Recent change: Increased email notification frequency for all users (daily digest changed to hourly)
Root cause: Root cause: SendGrid rate limit exceeded due to 10x increase in email volume from frequency change.
Resolution: Resolution: Implemented exponential backoff retry with queue prioritization. Upgraded SendGrid plan.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Simply retrying at maximum rate (caused further rate limiting).
Lesson: Lesson: Third-party API rate limits must be calculated before changing notification frequency.

Incident INC-1015 on API Gateway (Production): 503 Service Unavailable.
Severity: Critical.
Description: All traffic returning 503 for specific API version
Recent change: Deployed new API version routing rules to API Gateway
Root cause: Root cause: Routing rule typo sent /api/v2/* traffic to /dev/null upstream instead of v2 service cluster.
Resolution: Resolution: Fixed routing rule and redeployed. Traffic restored in 2 minutes.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Restarting v2 service instances (routing was sending traffic to wrong target).
Lesson: Lesson: API Gateway routing changes must be tested in staging with traffic simulation before production.

Incident INC-1016 on User API (Production): 500 Internal Server Error.
Severity: High.
Description: User profile updates failing
Recent change: Added new required field 'preferred_timezone' to user profile schema
Root cause: Root cause: New required column added without default value. Existing users missing the field cause NOT NULL constraint violations.
Resolution: Resolution: Added default value ('UTC') to column and backfilled existing records.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Rolling back API code (DB schema was already migrated in production).
Lesson: Lesson: Never add NOT NULL columns without default values. Use nullable or backfill strategy.

Incident INC-1017 on Redis Cache (Production): Cache Miss Storm.
Severity: Medium.
Description: Cache hit rate dropped from 95% to 12%
Recent change: Deployed application update with new cache key format
Root cause: Root cause: New cache key format invalidated all existing cached data simultaneously causing cache stampede.
Resolution: Resolution: Implemented cache warming with gradual migration period and dual-key support.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Flushing old cache manually (accelerated stampede rather than mitigating it).
Lesson: Lesson: Cache key format changes need migration strategy. Use versioned keys with warm-up period.

Incident INC-1018 on PostgreSQL Database (Production): Slow Queries.
Severity: Medium.
Description: Query performance degraded by 300% on high-traffic tables
Recent change: Disabled autovacuum during peak hours to reduce I/O
Root cause: Root cause: Table bloat from disabled autovacuum. TOAST entries accumulated, causing large sequential scans.
Resolution: Resolution: Re-enabled autovacuum, ran manual VACUUM ANALYZE on affected tables. Created vacuum schedule.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Adding indexes (did not help because statistics were stale).
Lesson: Lesson: Never disable autovacuum in production. Use cost-based autovacuum settings to minimize impact.

Incident INC-1019 on File Storage Service (Production): 403 Forbidden.
Severity: Medium.
Description: User unable to download their files
Recent change: Migrated file storage to new S3 bucket for cost optimization
Root cause: Root cause: New bucket IAM policy did not replicate user-level ACLs from old bucket.
Resolution: Resolution: Applied user-specific ACL migration script and updated IAM policy to include user-scoped permissions.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Making bucket public (unacceptable security risk).
Lesson: Lesson: S3 bucket migrations must include ACL validation step. Never sacrifice security for quick fixes.

Incident INC-1020 on Order Service (Production): Order Processing Delay.
Severity: High.
Description: Orders stuck in processing state for 30+ minutes
Recent change: Deployed order processing service update during business hours
Root cause: Root cause: Rolling deployment caused temporary queue consumer gap where orders queued but were not processed.
Resolution: Resolution: Drained queue with emergency consumer instances. Implemented zero-downtime deployment with overlapping consumers.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Restarting just the failed instances (missed that queue had backlog from deployment gap).
Lesson: Lesson: Stateful queue consumers need zero-downtime deployment strategy with backlog monitoring.

Incident INC-1021 on Payment API (Production): Payment Gateway Rejection.
Severity: Critical.
Description: All payment transactions rejected by gateway
Recent change: Upgraded payment gateway SDK to latest version
Root cause: Root cause: New SDK version changed certificate pinning hashes. Production environment had old pinned certificate hashes.
Resolution: Resolution: Updated certificate pinning configuration with new hashes from gateway documentation.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Downgrading SDK (caused different compatibility errors).
Lesson: Lesson: Read SDK upgrade notes for security configuration changes. Test payment flows end-to-end in staging.

Incident INC-1022 on Search Service (Production): High CPU Utilization.
Severity: High.
Description: Search latency at 15+ seconds, CPU at 100%
Recent change: Added fuzzy search with Levenshtein distance across all string fields
Root cause: Root cause: Fuzzy matching on all fields without index support caused O(n*m) computation on every query.
Resolution: Resolution: Limited fuzzy search to name/title fields only, implemented field-level result boosting.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Horizontal scaling (CPU was still maxed per instance).
Lesson: Lesson: Fuzzy/approximate matching is expensive. Apply only to indexed fields and limit distance threshold.

Incident INC-1023 on Authentication API (Production): Suspicious Authentication Activity.
Severity: Critical.
Description: Multiple accounts accessed from impossible geographic locations
Recent change: None - detected during security audit
Root cause: Root cause: JWT tokens stolen from insecure client-side storage (localStorage) and used from different locations.
Resolution: Resolution: Migrated tokens to httpOnly cookies, implemented IP binding for admin sessions, added device fingerprinting.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: IP-based blocking (attackers used VPN to match original IP).
Lesson: Lesson: Never store JWTs in localStorage. Use httpOnly cookies. Implement behavioral anomaly detection.

Severity: Medium.
Description: Mobile push notifications not delivered
Recent change: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) platform had minor service disruption
Root cause: Root cause: FCM service disruption caused delivery failures. No fallback notification mechanism existed.
Resolution: Resolution: Implemented SMS fallback for critical notifications when push delivery fails.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Retrying immediately (FCM still down, queue grew further).
Lesson: Lesson: Implement fallback delivery channels for critical notifications. Monitor third-party provider status pages.

Incident INC-1025 on API Gateway (Production): Mixed Content Errors.
Severity: High.
Description: Web clients reporting mixed content warnings blocking resources
Recent change: Added new API endpoints served from a microservice not behind the gateway
Root cause: Root cause: New microservice exposed HTTP endpoints directly without going through SSL-terminating API Gateway.
Resolution: Resolution: Routed all microservice traffic through API Gateway. Enforced HTTPS-only policy.
Failed attempt: Failed attempt: Setting HSTS header (did not fix existing HTTP endpoint exposure).
Lesson: Lesson: All service endpoints must be routed through API Gateway. Enforce TLS at gateway level, never bypass.
